query: From each public document tokens and source structural markup, reconstruct GUM/eRST primary discourse tree and secondary relations. Return exact zero-based half-open EDU token ranges, group structure and labeled parent/secondary edges. Deterministically select requested relation labels from the predicted graph.

task_definition.task: From each public document tokens and source structural markup, reconstruct GUM/eRST primary discourse tree and secondary relations. Return exact zero-based half-open EDU token ranges, group structure and labeled parent/secondary edges. Deterministically select requested relation labels from the predicted graph.
task_definition.input_notes: Source tokenization and selected source TEI layout plus speaker/addressee/incident metadata explicitly given as upstream transcription annotations. Not raw-audio perception. No normalized dates, summaries, sentence-type, transition, entity, EDU boundary or discourse target annotations. All source documents containing figure elements excluded by public source rule.
task_definition.environment_precedence: GUM-specific rules override RST-DT guidance; eRST formalism extends RST. No ANNIS lookup of current evaluation labels. Full theory papers provided as references; their combined page count is not a necessary-context claim.
limitations: No OS isolation or model execution
Independent source-entity and contamination confirmation pending

Source annotation-given transcription/layout, not raw visual or audio task
